entries.en: to give a feast, hold a banquet; to entertain with wine
to play host, act as host at a banquet ( tung-to, 'east road' = host)
entries.notes: 音写疑有鼻化号脱落，惟汉字東道与西语 Convite 互证清楚

entries.zh: 宴；王的宴席、官府宴饮（燕通宴）
entries.notes: 汉字有 [疑:宴] 标记，但 Convite del Rey 与闽南音 iēn 互证充分

entries.en: to attend a banquet, partake of a feast

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕瘙痒、癣疥一类皮肤 itch
entries.notes: 官话栏 [残]+T99 污损，汉字与音写均带 [疑]，仅西语 Comezon（痒）可据

entries.en: mark, streak on the skin; veining
entries.notes: 西语词头 matura/natu 存疑，四栏以汉字紋与 Būn 为准

entries.en: to perform a play, stage a comedy
entries.notes: 音写首音与西语 hazer la representarla 拼写有 [疑]，惟搬戲与官话对音 pān hī 互证

entries.zh: 做戏；编排戏文、编剧（后段 Pien hī/componer 或为夹注异文）
entries.en: to compose a play; to write/stage a drama
entries.notes: 西语 con- 处有涂改，闽南栏后段疑为夹注，主释做戲与官话 chō hī 互证

entries.en: to act in a play, perform a comedy

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕旦妆；戏中扮女角的旦角
entries.en: female impersonator on stage, actor playing a woman's role (dan make-up/role); damaged entry
entries.notes: 两音写栏均 [残]+T99，汉字妝/裝存疑，仅西语 Comediante q haze muger 与汉字旦妆可互证

entries.en: the dan (female-role) performer in a play

entries.notes: 闽南栏有涂改遮蔽声符（T99），汉字戲隊与官话 hī tūi 互证清楚
西语词头 Comedido/Comedio 存疑，音写 guiùn 两栏一致惟带 [疑]

entries.zh: 相推；相互推让（或推诿）；始、开始（Comencar/empecar 义，字迹潦草）
entries.en: to push or yield to one another mutually; to begin (comedimiento/commencing, entry scrawled)
entries.notes: 西语栏字迹潦草且 comedimiento/compappe/Comencar 并置费解，第二声符污损，释义存疑
第二音节 quey/guāy 存疑（g/k、quey/cài），惟汉字註解与官话 chū guāy 互证主义

entries.zh: 传；记载先人事迹之书、传记（如史传）
entries.en: a chuan (biographical) book, annal or chronicle recording the deeds of the ancients; commentary narrative
entries.notes: 闽南音写残缺潦草、西语末句潦草，惟西语释义（declara los hechos de los antepasados）与汉字傳互证
